programme.title: Ghost Dimension Lockdown: Ewloe Castle in North Wales
programme.desc: Ghost Dimension's Bex and Sean head to Ewloe Castle in North Wales, believed to be haunted by ghosts and spirits. What will they uncover as they delve deep into the castle ruins? and seek out its hauntings.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Final Session at Galleries of Justice
programme.desc: The Ghost Dimension team travel back in time to The Galleries of Justice in Nottingham. This was a one stop shop for justice where criminals were held awaiting trial.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Secret Nuclear Bunker
programme.desc: Ghost Dimension investigate Hack Green Secret Nuclear Bunker in Nantwich. Something sinister and paranormal seems to be causing havoc inside of the building and tonight it unleashes powerful activity

programme.desc: Sean explores The Shakespeare pub in Manchester and meets Flecky Bennett to investigate claims dating back hundreds of years, about an evil chef that is haunting the pub.

programme.desc: Derek Acorah's The Past Hunters investigate Thackray Medical Museum, believed to one of Leeds most haunted buildings. Workers claim to have witnessed constant paranormal activity in the museum and one claim is that two Victorian ghosts are trapped...

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!
programme.desc: Alt er lov i krig og kjærlighet – eller? Enda en gjest sjekker inn og skaper trøbbel i paradis. To gutter står nå i fare og må kjempe for sine plasser på hotellet.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!
programme.desc: Ett par får en stor makt som skaper usikkerhet i gjengen. Hvem ender opp med det sorte hjertet og må sjekke ut før parseremonien?

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!
programme.desc: Vampyra hersker over det mørke riket og sprer frykt i paradis. Guttene må underkaste seg hennes vilje i jakten på en partner.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!
programme.desc: Det er vampyrfest på hotellet og Maiken er på jakt etter sitt neste offer. Gjestene våkner fyllesyke til nyheten om blodige egg og hva som egentlig skjedde på Solo.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!
programme.desc: En fredning er i spill og det tas et brutalt valg på ukens parseremoni. Men har gjestene husket å ikke bli brikker i Vampyras spill?

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!
programme.desc: Aladdin og prinsessen sjekker inn til både stor glede og frustrasjon hos de andre gjestene. Et hemmelig oppdrag skaper kaos på hotellet.

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 902
programme.desc: Amalie Snøløs drømmer om å kjøpe et oppussingsobjekt! Men har hun egentlig tid til det? Solfrid og André har spurt Hans Christian om hjelp til å finne drømmehuset, men ikke for enhver pris.

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 903
programme.desc: Hanne kjøpte drømmeboligen som viste seg å være infisert av både rotter og skjeggkre. Etter sitt forrige bomkjøp håper hun at Hans Christian kan hjelpe. Og Christian skal kjøpe sin første leilighet.

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 904
programme.desc: Positivitetsblogger Petter ønsker å bo nærmere sentrum, men klarer Karianne å finne den perfekte guttebula? Camilla og Jon Erik trenger mer plass og får hjelp av Hans Christian.

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 905
programme.desc: Iselinn og Ron er helt uenige om hvor de vil bo. Klarer Karianne å løse en tilnærmet umulig oppgave? Gårdsguttene Kim og Ole Johnny er på jakt etter et idyllisk gårdsbruk med skog og egen strandlinje.

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 906
programme.desc: Karianne får et viktig oppdrag med å hjelpe alenemamma Samia i hus før mammapermisjonen er over – men holder budsjettet? Hans Christian møter Johanna og Joakim som er på jakt etter drømmehagen.

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 1001
programme.desc: Ingrid bor på leilighetshotell med sine to barn, og er desperat etter å få en ny start, og skape et hjem sammen med familien. Småbarnsforeldrene Toril og Eivind vil ut av leiligheten sin i Oslo-gryta.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 222
programme.desc: I dag er det menysmaking på Camp Kulinaris og deltakerne er spent på Kjartans tilbakemeldinger på bryllupsmaten de lager.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 223
programme.desc: Det er bryllup på Camp Kulinaris! I dag må alt være perfekt og det er null rom for å feile når gruppa har ansvaret for den største dagen i et ungt pars liv.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 224
programme.desc: I dag må restaurantsjefen velge en lærling som må forsvare plassen sin på Camp Kulinaris. Det blir en jevn og dramatisk lærlingkamp der to deltakere møtes til sudden death.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 225
programme.desc: Det er den siste uken før finaleuken og Kjartan har med den vanskeligste oppgaven som er laget i Camp kulinaris historie.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 226
programme.desc: Det er klart for menysmaking og restaurantsjefen må lede gruppen gjennom den avanserte menyen fra Kjartans egen restaurant, Tango.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 227
programme.desc: I dag kommer Kjartan og alle hans ansatte fra restauranten Tango. Deltakerne må levere en plettfri servering og restaurantsjefen er nervøs.

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 1302
programme.desc: Familien fra Harstad er tilbake! Og for å slippe lastebiltrøbbel, har onkel Erling bestilt en sjåfør. Kai Thomas vil på stranda, men Aurora er mer opptatt av hundene sine.

programme.title: Charterfeber
programme.desc: Charter-Svein er tilbake, og med seg på lasset har han sine tre like energiske barn Noah, Liam og Ylva. Roger drar til havs for å fiske hai og har en opplevelsesrik tur på sjøen.

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 1304
programme.desc: Buskeruddamene har landet og er klare for irish og strawberry. De må bare få permobil-lappen først. Det er onkel Erlings drømmedag og han har planlagt aktiviteter for gjengen de sikkert vil elske.

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 1305
programme.desc: Haider tar gladelig på seg rollen som Baywatch-stjerne da familien trenger opplæring i livredning. Rockeren Geir vil gjengjelde Fred Åges godhet og har planlagt en dag full av gaver og overraskelser.

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 1306
programme.desc: På Gran Canaria tar kjærligheten, vennskapet og små hverdagsdramaer uventede vendinger. Haider håper på en romantisk date med Neelam, Pondern og Mutza sliter med å mestre en nøkkelboks.

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 1307
programme.desc: Roger våkner etter mareritt og må vaske klær etter noen hete og svette dager på øya. Pondern og Mutza setter i gang fyllestream med utfordringer, og Buskerud-gjengen legger ut på delfinsafari.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 509
programme.desc: Et gammelt gårdstun fra 1800 tallet på Oppdal i Trøndelag pusses opp. Den gamle bygningen moderniseres uten å fjerne den gode sjelen og følelsen.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 506
programme.desc: Et gammelt fiskemottak på Sandøya står foran et ansiktsløft. Her skal de ville kreftene fra Atlanteren få komme til syne inn i bygget, og det blir muligheter for å trekke torsk rett opp fra sofakroken.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 603

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 303
programme.desc: En gammel låve skal pusses opp i Bauge, og Halvor har sett at det ligger et enormt potensiale blant halmballer, skakke benker og gamle jordbruksredskaper.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 101
programme.desc: Interiørdesigner Halvor Bakke drar på tur til Todalen, med de nevedyktige kameratene Mikkel, Gustav og Thomas, for å pusse opp en klassisk seter i idylliske Trollheimen.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 201
programme.desc: I kveld skal Halvor og gutta ta på seg veldig spesielt prosjekt i indre Telemark. Et gammelt forsvarsbygg skal forvandles til en moderne og stilren familiehytte

programme.title: Luksusfellen

programme.title: Luksusfellen: Episode 2305

programme.title: Luksusfellen: Episode 2306

programme.title: Luksusfellen: Episode 2307

programme.title: Luksusfellen: Episode 2308

programme.title: World War II in HD Colour: Britain at Bay
programme.desc: Germany makes critical errors during the bombing of Britain.

programme.title: World War II in HD Colour: Victory in Europe
programme.desc: In 1945, Germany is crumbly on both fronts. The Western Allies cross the Rhine and take most of Germany, while the Red Army quickly advances into Berlin. After Hitler's suicide, Germany surrenders and is divided among the allied powers.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Becoming Respectable
programme.desc: In 1924, Hitler is convicted for High Treason after the failed Nazi power grab. In prison, he writes Mein Kampf, articulating his anti-Semitic and expansionist beliefs. Upon release, Hitler rebrands the Nazi Party.

programme.title: The Real Oppenheimer
programme.desc: I 1945 ble verden ført inn i atomalderen. Rollen hans som "Father of the Bomb" var satt , og Oppenheimer ble stadig mer bekymret for den potensielle faren denne vitenskapelige oppfinnelser kunne utgjøre for menneskeheten.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Jews Who Fought for Hitler
programme.desc: In Hitler’s Germany, those with Jewish ancestry faced harsh Nuremberg Laws. Full Jews faced death; Mischlinge endured discrimination, job bans. Some, like Helmut Schmidt, unaware of heritage, found protectors like Milch in high places.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Mill Street Barracks
programme.desc: Built in 1861 Mill Street Barracks is steeped in rich history. It has accommodated many branches of the armed forces throughout its life. Like many other barracks it has also been used as a morgue making it a prime location for the supernatural.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Cheri Oteri, Corbin Bernsen, John Schneider, Sharon Angela
programme.desc: After the tragic loss of her father, Cheri Oteri visits a medium who channels his spirit from the other side.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Regis Philbin, Harry Hamlin, Ana Gasteyer, Jaime King
programme.desc: Regis Philbin spends a terrifying night in a notorious haunted house trying to coax its ghosts into sight; Harry Hamlin's wedding proposal is foiled by a ghost with a broken heart.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Bret Michaels, Natasha Henstridge, Penelope Ann Miller, Eva Amurri
programme.desc: Faced with a decision that would change his life, Bret Michaels is visited by a close relative who points him toward his destiny.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Jerry Stiller, Mindy McCready, Nick Hogan, Lourdes Benedicto
programme.desc: Jerry Stiller receives a long awaited message from his father; a maternal figure appears to Mindy McCready at one of the darkest moments of her life.

programme.title: The Haunting Of. . .: Diane Farr
programme.desc: Actress Diane Farr (Numb3rs, Private Practice) fears that a ghost is causing unexplained havoc in her California home.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Chaka Khan, Kristin Bauer, Iqbal Theba
programme.desc: Chaka Khan is saved by a guardian angel; Kristin Bauer comes face to face with the spirit of her father; and Iqbal Theba is terrorized by a demonic spirit.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Titus Welliver, Johnny Gill, Marcus Schenkenberg
programme.desc: Titus' family buys a summer home in Maine and discovers that the malevolent spirits living in their barn were murdered in a mass killing right on their property.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Sugar Ray Leonard, Aida Turturro, Larry Manetti, Johnathon Schaech
programme.desc: Battling with inner demons after retiring, Sugar Ray Leonard is awoken one evening by the appearance of a mysterious young girl.

programme.title: Death Walker with Nick Groff: Niagara Club
programme.desc: Nick investigates a partially vacant building that was once home to a thriving social club.

programme.title: My Ghost Story: I Am Full of Madness
programme.desc: A man captures evidence of powerful poltergeists who threaten to steal the souls of his family. A woman makes contact with a dozen entities and has the stunning photos to show for it.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Insect Clues
programme.desc: Between 1985 and 1988, 18 people were choked, molested and left for dead in the remote mountains of California. The only witnesses were the insects — and they play an important role in solving the crimes and bringing the killer to justice.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Southside Strangler
programme.desc: Timothy Wilson Spencer was identified as the man who raped and strangled five young women in Virginia. With the use of DNA profiling, an innocent man is freed and the real killer is convicted.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Legionnaires' Disease
programme.desc: After a Philadelphia Convention, 180 Legionnaires contract pneumonia-like symptoms and 29 of them die. The determination of one scientist helps identify the cause of this deadly disease.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The List Murders
programme.desc: In 1971, John List left a note with the bodies of his mother, wife and three children in his mansion ballroom before disappearing completely. Detectives must solve the case, despite having only an outdated photograph of List.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hunter's Target
programme.desc: Over a thousand hunting accidents are reported in the United States each year. Fewer than ten percent of them are fatal. But when one hunter's death seemed suspicious, the FBI was called in to investigate.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cracking The Cartel
programme.desc: A mother and child are kidnapped a bystander is murdered. Violence such as this shattered a quiet Texas neighborhood and exposed a drug cartel that flourished where it was least expected.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dead Run
programme.desc: In Pennsylvania, an inmate escaped with the help of his female accomplice. Following a trail of fraudulent credit card receipts and deaths, authorities track the pair, but always find themselves one step behind.

programme.title: The FBI Files: First and Kennedy Street Crew
programme.desc: In the early 1990's, Washington, D.C., became the murder capital of the nation. Few were left untouched by gang violence, which was ignited by the drug trade. By 1994, that violence would strike at the very heart of law enforcement.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Flames Of Justice
programme.desc: Arson fires are set for their own sake, or to cover a different crime, such as murder. Think fire consumes all vital clues? Think again. Arson investigators can glean important clues from scorched rubble and ignite the unquenchable flames of justice.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Invisible Death
programme.desc: Poison is an almost invisible form of death, and toxicologists must look for hidden clues in blood and tissue to bring these murders to light.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Shattered Vows
programme.desc: A woman is found dead at the bottom of the basement stairs. As detectives look into the accident, they begin to question the sequence of events.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Out Of The Grave
programme.desc: New Forensic Techniques used to Solve Old Cases: Advancement in science and technology are encouraging people to revisit the past in hopes of answering questions that have remained unanswered, and solving crimes that seemed unsolvable.

programme.title: The New Detectives: From The Ashes
programme.desc: Arson Investigation: Insurance torchings, mob burnouts and arson murders: these crimes are designed to take all clues with them. But a solid case can be built from a heap of ashes.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: I Did It To Hurt You
programme.desc: Aeshia’s here to prove to Terrence and his wife Lashondra that Terrence is the father of her child, but Lashondra knows she’s wrong! Both Shaunah and Chris have convinced themselves that they’re being cheated on. Who’s the father?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: I Left You, But You Are The Father
programme.desc: Anastasia and Robert's 2 year relationship crumbled when he heard rumors that she was cheating on him. She says that she's always been faithful, but Robert doesn't believe her and now he doubts he is the father of her newborn baby.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Did The Babysitter Abuse My Child?
programme.desc: Stephanie says that ever since she came home from work to find her 1-year-old with a black eye, she has feared that her children's babysitter harms them. Sitter Cheryl denies some serious accusations about a child.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: We Can't Live Like This
programme.desc: Thornton says he can't trust his cheating girlfriend Crystal and wants her to take a lie detector test! Plus, Stephanie wants to prove to her husband Mathew that she's not having sex with her own family member! She wants the accusations put to rest.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: I'm Raising Him, But Is He Mine?
programme.desc: Deshawn claims that his ex Lynette abandoned their 5-year-old son. But she claims that he is keeping her from their child. However, Deshawn recently found out that he isn't listed on his son's birth certificate, so he wants a DNA test!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: I Know About the Affair, But Is He the Father?
programme.desc: Stephanie gave birth to a baby boy and believes Brandon is the father. But Brandon claims he didn't find out about the child until three years later and denies being the father. Stephanie and her mother want Brandon to step up.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Steve Gets The Real Update
programme.desc: Megan wanted to find out if her boyfriend Devin was cheating. But even darker relationship secrets surface! Plus, you'll be shocked to find out why Laura and Steven need Steve's help again!

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: New Year's Evil
programme.desc: It’s New Year’s Eve weekend, and in the midst of the revelry Miguel Mendez is beaten to death outside a convenience store. Lt. Joe Kenda faces a challenging investigation.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Metal on Metal
programme.desc: A athlete is gunned down just weeks before starting college, leaving family heartbroken and detectives stumped. The man seems an unlikely target, until Lt. Joe Kenda pries into his personal life.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Justified
programme.desc: A young man is found gunned down, leading Lt. Joe Kenda to delve into his troubled past and his connection to the world of rare coins.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Magic Bullet
programme.desc: A hard-working father of two is shot in the head just steps from a notorious strip club. The case is stuck in neutral until Kenda uncovers a conspiracy organized by an unlikely triggerman.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: The Cage
programme.desc: Kenda finds the bullet-ridden bodies of a middle-aged couple in a musty suburban house alongside the corpses of their two beloved pets.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Shattered
programme.desc: When two teens discover a lifeless body in the street, Lt. Joe Kenda must determine if the killer was a jealous lover or just plain unhinged.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Astronauts
programme.desc: Who are these people that venture into space? Once they were test pilots, then scientists and engineers now teachers, politicians and paying tourists what does it take to earn the astronaut wings?

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Space: Getting There
programme.desc: The new surge in space transportation, privately owned companies vying for government contracts and private entrepreneurs looking to build hotels in space.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Orbit
programme.desc: Chances are, you are watching this program by satellite, one way or the other. Every day we use these wonders of human design, from communication and weather observation, to GPS and recourse management.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Shore to Shore
programme.desc: With low Earth orbit delegated to private companies, NASA is free to develop the deep space hardware for missions to Mars and beyond. The Orion space craft and SLS launch system are well on their way to delivering this capability.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Mars: Adapt or Leave
programme.desc: Air, water, food, electricity and fuel all the essentials to explore the solar system, this episode explores the innovative plans for astronauts to grow their own food and extract water and fuel at their destinations.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Emissiaries
programme.desc: NASA and others are developing new innovative propulsion systems, Ion thrusters, solar sails and the science fiction 'Warp drive' is not as far away as once thought.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Danger, Asteroids Ahead
programme.desc: The threat of an asteroid strike is a very real danger in our solar system, mankind is now in a position to defend the planet from such an eventuality.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: First Light
programme.desc: The Hubble Telescope is nearing its end, the replacements are ready to go, ready to peer further back in time and space than can be imagined.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Stars Above
programme.desc: The life cycle of stars reveal to us the past and the future of Earth and ourselves.

programme.title: Bizarre Murders: American Booty
programme.desc: While her swinging husband is out of town, a successful New Hampshire woman is beaten to death with a sex paddle.

programme.title: Bizarre Murders: Hemlock Killer
programme.desc: When a woman is poisoned by an obscure plant, detectives launch an undercover operation to outsmart a bookish murder mystery buff with a short fuse.

programme.title: Bizarre Murders: Emoji Overkill
programme.desc: A Texas father takes his spoiled teenage daughter to an exclusive Caribbean resort and somehow ends up packed in his own suitcase.

programme.title: Bizarre Murders: Ice Queen
programme.desc: A homicidal vegan gelato maker gets her just desserts after two bodies are found in her freezer.

programme.title: Bizarre Murders: Psychic Sleuth
programme.desc: The head of a family-run maple syrup business disappears, and a psychic claims she's buried somewhere in the sugar shack.

programme.title: Cops: An Innocent Gardener
programme.desc: Officers pursue a vehicle that struck a police car. Two men deny the lawnmower in their truck was stolen. Deputies are called when a mother attempts to run her daughter over.

programme.title: Cops: Penalty Box
programme.desc: A man sneaking away from a bar fight clams he was chased by a truck. Deputies are called when a woman assaults people at a skating rink. A drunk man abandons his truck on train tracks.

programme.title: Cops: Pup and Rescue
programme.desc: A driver denies ownership of what police find in his car. Police conduct a narcotics sting that nets several arrests. A deputy removes a pooch from the scene of an accident.

programme.title: Cops: Undercover Blues
programme.desc: Police work a sting that targets drug dealers. An undercover sting uncovers narcotics trafficking. Police respond to a burglary in progress and discover a flop house.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: On the Move

programme.title: Cops: Heat of the Moment

programme.title: Cops: Odd Man Out

programme.title: Cops: Bikini Brawl
programme.desc: Officers are called when a mother's job hunt takes a turn for the worse, and deputies confront a nervous man with a lot of bad habits.

programme.title: Cops: A Man Without a Plan
programme.desc: A young man receives a wake-up call when police catch him breaking the law, and officers play peacemakers after a board game sparks a family feud.

programme.title: Cops: The Truth Is Key
programme.desc: A desperate suspect flees from the cops after shots are fired, and a father and daughter are caught off-guard when they run into a man wielding a screwdriver.

programme.title: Cops: Mother Knows Best

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Crime Scene Solvers: Killer Cop (Tavernier Case)
programme.desc: Firefighters in Barbizieux, Charente, are called to a fire in a large house in the village. They arrive to find the lifeless body of the owner, Claude Tavernier, 83, lying in a large pool of blood.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: A Fatal Student Night (Stéphane Kameugne Case)
programme.desc: On December 24, 2008, the body of Stéphane Kameugne was fished out from a canal in Châlons-en-Champagne. The young man had been missing for two weeks and no one had seen him since the evening of his graduation ceremony from his engineering school

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Crime Scene Solvers: A Deadly Date On the Internet (Ciampi case)
programme.desc: Marina Ciampi, 52, is found dead at her home in Marseille. The victim is naked on her bed, a plastic bag over her head. But no trace of a break-in is detected.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Crime Scene Solvers: Death Trap On the Road (Schaaf Case)
programme.desc: A damaged bike belonging to Karine Schaaff, 16, is found abandoned by the side of a road in Moselle.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Strange Farm: The Anaïs Guillaume Affair
programme.desc: On the night of April 16, 2013, Anaïs Guillaume, 21, mysteriously disappears in Fromy (Ardennes) after spending the evening at her companion's farm.

programme.title: Norske Krimsaker: Episode 303
programme.desc: Tidlig på 90-tallet rystes den norske befolkningen av flere kirkebranner. I 1993 blir Øystein Aarseth funnet død i en trappeoppgang i Oslo. Politiet retter søkelyset mot enkelte personer i black-metal-miljøet. En av disse er Varg Vikernes.

programme.title: Norske Krimsaker: Episode 401
programme.desc: I mai 1995 blir 17 år gamle Birgitte Tengs funnet drept bare noen få hundre meter unna sitt hjem i Kopervik på Karmøy. Saken fører til omfattende etterforskning, og Birgittes fetter havner raskt i søkelyset.

programme.title: Svenske krimsaker: Episode 703
programme.desc: 18 år gamle Ndella Jack har nettopp kommet hjem fra bryllupsreise med mannen sin. Det som skulle være starten på deres liv sammen, får i stedet en brå slutt, da de blir ofre for et brutalt angrep.

programme.title: Svenske krimsaker: Episode 606
programme.desc: Den siste gangen Fatima Berggren ble sett i live var på hennes 57-årsdag i mai 2017. Saken blir først betraktet som en kidnapping, men uten livstegn fra Fatima, anser politiet det snart som en drapssak.

programme.title: Svenske krimsaker: Episode 602
programme.desc: En regnfull morgen den 19. oktober 2004 dreper en ukjent mann en åtte år gammel gutt og en 56 år gammel kvinne i Linköping. Gjerningsmannen forsvinner sporløst og politiet må nå finne ut hvem han er.

programme.title: Norske Krimsaker: Episode 205
programme.desc: Etter meldinger om et rykende bål i Hafjell går drapsalarmen hos politiet på Lillehammer. På bålet viser det seg å ligge rester av et partert menneske. Samtidig meldes to personer savnet fra en bolig i nærheten.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene redder Cowboyfesten / Valpene redder Cali
programme.desc: Det er cowboyfest i byen, men når en flokk kuer rømmer fra togvognen, må Ryder og Paw Patrol redde festen. // Alex vil gjerne være med i Paw Patrol, men han ødelegger mer enn han hjelper til når de skal redde Cali fra låven til Yumi bonde.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder Bukta / Valpene Redder en Goodway
programme.desc: En oljetanker har sprunget lekk i Adventure-bukta og Ryder og Paw Patrol må renske opp oljen. // Ryder og Paw Patrol må hjelpe ordfører Goodway med å få opp en berømt statue som har havnet i vannet.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Sitter Tvillingvakt / Valpene Redder Fyrverkeriet
programme.desc: Ordfører Goodway ringer Paw Patrol for å få dem til å redde nevøen og niesen hennes ned fra et tre og for at de skal passe på tvillingene for en dag // Ordfører Goodway forventer en eske med fyrverkeri, men mottar en pakke med grisunger!

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder en Hav-Valp
programme.desc: Når Valpene og Cap'N Turbot er ute under den veldig sjeldne Magiske Hav Månen, begynner magiske ting å skje. Lokket av den mystiske Hav-Valp sangen blir PAW Patrol plutselig forvandlet til Hav-Valper.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene på Glatta / Valpene Redder en Basketballkamp
programme.desc: En vinterstorm skaper trøbbel for hele Adventure Bukta. // Ordfører Goodway utfordrer ordfører Humdinger's basketballag til en kamp. Det eneste Ordfører Goodway mangler er et, Basketballag!

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder en Pizza / Valpene Redder Skye
programme.desc: Alex og Herr Porter leverer pizzadeig til et stort selskap når de mister kontrollen over bilen. Valpene må redde dem! // Skye er på vei til Jake-fjellet når hun krasjer i snøen. Ryder ringer Everest for å redde dagen.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder Pingvinene / Valpene Redder en Delfinunge
programme.desc: Noen har sveipet fisk av båten til Cap'n Turbot, så han kaller på Ryder og PAW Patrol som hjelper ham i etterforskningen. // Ved hjelp av sitt nye spion utstyr, inspiserer Chase båten og under dekk oppdager han en gruppe Pingviner.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder Walinda / Valpene Redder et Stort Bein
programme.desc: Paw Patrol planlegger en spesiell feiring av Wally. Når han ikke kommer, må de finne hans spesielle venn Walinda. // Under Cap'n Turbots arkeologiske utgraving kommer et dinosaurbein til syne etter et steinras.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder en Elefantfamilie / Valpene og de Slemme Kattene
programme.desc: Valpenes kjøretur over savannen blir til en redningsaksjon og en familiegjenforening for en elefantfamilie. // Valpene må redde Adventure bukta fra de slemme kattene for å vinne en stor premie.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene lar Marshall Være Alene Hjemme / Valpene Redder Hjortefamilien
programme.desc: Når de andre valpene er på fallskjermtrening må Marshall få en gruppe med kattunger tilbake helt alene. // Ryder og PAW Patrol redder en hjortefamilie som sitter fast på den glatte isen.

programme.title: iCarly: Tvillinger

programme.title: iCarly: iKamp mot Dingo

programme.desc: Da Sam kommer til å avsløre overfor Carly at hun og Freddie smugkysset, konfronterer Carly dem med hvorfor de ikke fortalte henne om det. Og Spencer underviser fanger i billedkunst i fengselet.

programme.desc: Når Carl, Sam og Freddie vinner over en berømt tv-kokk i en matlagningskonkurranse, vil ikke kokken lage mat mer og nekter å komme ut av soverommet sitt. Spencer prøver å oppfylle en fremtidsdrøm.

programme.title: iCarly: Rektor kampen

programme.title: iCarly: iSpeed Date
programme.desc: Så mange gutter dukker opp til 'ta Carly med på fest'-konkurransen, at Carly, Sam og Freddie må benytte speed-dating for å møte dem alle sammen. Spencer følger et merkelig treningsprogram fra en ny app.

programme.title: iCarly: Stjernehjelp
programme.desc: Når Carly, Sam og Freddie skal lage en musikkvideo til en popstjernes comeback, oppdager de at popstjernen er ute av form og talentløs. Og Spencer oppdager at kvinnen han dater er Gibbys mor.

programme.title: Bulderhuset: Spøkelset

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Frankensteins eksperiment

programme.title: Bulderhuset: Innhøsteren / Bulder-redet

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Candy Sale / To the Rescue

programme.title: Key & Peele: Terrorist Meeting

programme.title: Key & Peele: Slap-Ass: In Recovery
programme.desc: En baseballspiller slåss med sin avhengighet av rumpeklapsing, en mafioso tar hevn og Steve Urkel driver en mann til vanvidd.

programme.title: Key & Peele: The End
programme.desc: Ray Parker Jr. har noen nye låter, en mann kan ikke slutte å si "deez nuts", Keegan må ringe 112 og en ung mann lærer om Negrotown.

programme.title: Key & Peele: The Power of Wings
programme.desc: Inkluderer sketsjer der Keegan og Jordan avlytter hvite kvinner som elsker svarte menn, Wendell lager en musikkvideo og Kareem og Jahar går på treningssenteret.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Sex Addict Wendel
programme.desc: Artister blir sparket i skrittet på grunn av kunsten sin, klassens klovn terroriserer læreren og en mann prøver å få hellet med seg på et møte for sexmisbrukere.

programme.title: Key & Peele: MC Mom
programme.desc: En gangster deltar i et skuddrama, en mor skriver en sang til sønnen sin, to bondefangere konkurrerer, Big Boi møter André 3000 og to karer kommer ut for en bilulykke.

programme.title: Key & Peele: The 420 Special
programme.desc: Neil deGrasse Tyson slapper av hjemme, Keegan må bevare fatningen under et jobbintervju, en skredder får en klient med luft i magen, parkeringsvaktene diskuterer 'Game of Thrones' og en telefonselger prøver en ny strategi.

programme.title: Key & Peele: The Branding
programme.desc: Jordan og Keegan utforsker opplevelsen som sort collegestudent og snylterne som suksess medfører. Andre sketsjer inkluderer et nabolags reaksjon på et mystisk vesen, når man kan - og ikke kan - si et kontroversielt ord.

programme.title: Key & Peele: The Job Interview
programme.desc: Dommer Jessie har et nytt program, en mann venter på et jobbintervju, to damer sludrer, parkeringsvakter diskuterer Val Kilmer, en pensjonert mann fra hæren hører om et nytt prosjekt og en kvinne introduserer sin forlovede for foreldrene.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Bitch
programme.desc: I denne seriepremierer av komiprogrammet prøver Jordan Peele og Keegan Michael Key å si et forbudt ord om deres kvinner, Lil Wayne venner seg til livet bak lås og slå, og president Obama uttrykker hva han egentlig føler.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Joke Stealing
programme.desc: Sketsjene inkluderer en fotballspiller som blir straffet for å juble for mye, Jordan og Keegan som går på premieren på "Othello" og en high school-elev som blir berømt for å stjele en vits.

programme.title: Broad City: The Lockout
programme.desc: Når Abbi får sprøytet leiligheten sin mot skadedyr og Ilana mister nøklene sine, blir jentene nødt til å bo på gaten - akkurat når Abbi har sin første kunstutstilling.

programme.title: Broad City: P*$$Y Weed
programme.desc: Jentene må bli voksne! Abbi vil kjøpe sin egen marihuana, som en voksen kvinne, mens Ilana må takle skatten på egen hånd. Og, jentene er høye som hus.

programme.title: Broad City: Fattest Asses
programme.desc: Når Abbi innser at hun er for snill, blir hun mere bitchy. Ilana bestemmer seg for å nå sitt fulle potential. De går på en eksklusiv fest og møter noen eventyrlige DJ-er. Nå kan ingenting gå galt.

programme.title: Broad City: Hurricane Wanda
programme.desc: Abbi og Ilana klarer sig igennem stormen med hjælp fra deres venner (Jaimé, Lincoln og Jeremy), men de får desværre selskab af Bevers og hans søster. Et spil 'Who Done It?' udspiller sig, mens orkanan raser udenfor.

programme.title: Broad City: In Heat
programme.desc: Ilana leter febrilsk etter en gave i siste øyeblikk til Lincoln, mens Abbi prøver å finne et klimaanlegg for å få det kjølig på soveværelset.

programme.title: Broad City: Mochalatta Chills
programme.desc: Der dukker opp nye muligheter når Abbi endelig kan trene noen på Soulstice og Ilana gjør suksess som firmasjef.

programme.title: Broad City: Wisdom Teeth
programme.desc: Abbi skal trekke visdomstennene og Ilana ser det som sin plikt å passe henne til hun får det bedre - noe som selvfølgelig innebærer en masse 'medikamenter' og en total mangel på tilsyn.

programme.title: Broad City: Knockoffs
programme.desc: Abbi og Jeremy går på en date som ender med en overraskelse. Ilana og hennes mor leter etter den perfekte håndvesken.

programme.title: Broad City: Hashtag FOMO
programme.desc: Jentene leter etter den perfekte fest, noe som avslører en underlig og surrealistisk side av Abbi, som igjen bekrefter Ilanas verste anelser.

programme.title: Broad City: Citizen Ship
programme.desc: Gjengen skal feire at Jaime har blitt amerikansk statsborger, men Bevers fører Abbi og Ilana på avveier med å love dem gratis sprit. Imens må Lincoln og Jaime klare seg selv blandt alle advokatene.

programme.title: Broad City: Coat Check
programme.desc: Abbi prøver å finne en forsvunnet frakk, mens Ilana utforsker en ny romanse - som føles merkelig kjent.

programme.desc: Daniel gir en gutt som ikke er mikroovnsikker nettoprettelse, prøver å etterligne talkshows med dumme quizzer i stedet for å være morsom og gjør det gøy å sørge over sin elskede.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Fedora Hero Saves Eggs
programme.desc: Daniel løfter på hatten for en ydmykt skrytende helt, snakker med seg selv som tenåring og hjelper to usedvanlige mennesker med å finne hverandre.

programme.title: Tosh.0: High School Football Fan

programme.title: Tosh.0: How To Give A BJ

programme.title: Tosh.0: 715

programme.title: Tosh.0: Angelo Garcia, He-Man
programme.desc: Daniel lar oss møte en tidligere barnestjerne som kler seg ut som He-Man, viser at havrekjeks forvandler folk til løgnere og selger sine mest verdifulle eiendeler.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Welven Da Great

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Jews Who Fought for Hitler
programme.desc: In Hitler’s Germany, those with Jewish ancestry faced harsh Nuremberg Laws. Full Jews faced death; Mischlinge endured discrimination, job bans. Some, like Helmut Schmidt, unaware of heritage, found protectors like Milch in high places.

programme.title: World War II in HD Colour: Hitler Strikes East
programme.desc: The German invasion of Russia from Operation Barbarossa on 22 June 1941 to Kursk on 5 July 1943.

programme.title: Auschwitz: The Nazis and the Final Solution: Surprising Beginnings
programme.desc: Tyske kommandører oppdager effektiviteten i å gasse fanger, og Auschwitz forvandles fra en liten bakgårdsleir for de som motarbeider den nazistiske okkupasjonen av Polen, til en storstilt utryddelsesleir for jøder.

programme.title: Secret War: Christine Granville
programme.desc: Christine Granville, aka Krystyna Skarbek, a brave SOE agent, secured the release of captured comrades from the Gestapo before Operation Dragoon, earning the George Medal.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Dutch Collaborator
programme.desc: Anton Adriaan Mussert, initially resisted Hitler’s anti-Semitism despite modeling his NSB party, even welcoming Jewish members. His failed attempt to kidnap Queen Wilhelmina led him into hiding, after which he collaborated in hopes of gaining power.

programme.title: The Haunting Of. . .: Diane Farr
programme.desc: Actress Diane Farr (Numb3rs, Private Practice) fears that a ghost is causing unexplained havoc in her California home.

programme.title: The Haunting Of. . .: Loni Love
programme.desc: Comedienne Loni Love returns to the hotel in Winston-Salem, North Carolina where she had an experience so terrifying, she fled in the middle of the night.

programme.title: The Haunting Of. . .: Lou Gossett Jr.
programme.desc: Academy award-winning actor Louis Gossett Jr. anxiously returns to the hotel in Louisiana where angry spirits surrounded him over 30 years ago.

programme.title: The Haunting Of. . .: Jonathan Bennett
programme.desc: Actor Jonathan Bennett (Mean Girls, All My Children) has been sensing a dark spirit in his new home, where all of his electronics seem to have minds of their own.

programme.title: Dirty Home Rescue: Episode 1
programme.desc: In this brand-new series of Dirty Home Rescue, Hayley Leitch and her cleaning team Tom Swire and Chesley Medley-Brown go to the rescue of Toni from Telford whose house is so dirty her partner of 10 years, Rich, won’t move in with her.

programme.title: Dirty Home Rescue: Episode 2
programme.desc: Hayley Leitch and her cleaning team Tom Swire and Chesley Medley-Brown go to the rescue of Bill and Antionette from Newport, who share their home with their 3 cats. They admit they’ve not deep cleaned their home since they moved in.

programme.title: My Ghost Story: I Am Full of Madness
programme.desc: A man captures evidence of powerful poltergeists who threaten to steal the souls of his family. A woman makes contact with a dozen entities and has the stunning photos to show for it.

programme.title: Death Walker with Nick Groff
programme.desc: With exclusive permission, Nick and Tessa embark as the inaugural paranormal investigators to explore the extensive Eastern Niagara Hospital. Their goal is to establish contact with the spirits of past patients rumored to haunt its halls.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Rebecca De Mornay, Michael Rapaport, Margaret Cho
programme.desc: Faced with the possibility of death, Rebecca De Mornay is greeted by angelic spirits. A young Michael Rapaport and friends stumble upon ghosts in their high school basement.

programme.title: My Ghost Story: Life After Death
programme.desc: A tourist says he was knifed in the back by a violent ghost in Tombstone, Ariz.; a dead wife jealously haunts her husband and his new girlfriend; and a woman snaps the picture of a smiling apparition.

programme.title: The Haunting Of. . .: Roddy Piper
programme.desc: "Rowdy" Roddy Piper (legendary WWE wrestler) is paid a visit by Kim at his home in Portland, Oregon as he seeks answers to the ghost experiences.

programme.title: Death Walker with Nick Groff
programme.desc: “The Body Shop”, a gentlemen's club shrouded in mystery and inexplicable occurrences. The night before Nick and Tessa's arrival, an unexplained fire engulfed a truck in the parking lot, with security footage showing no signs of arson.

programme.title: The Hills: Timing is Everything
programme.desc: Når Laurens harde jobbing under moteuken i L.A. fører til tidenes største karrieremulighet, føler hun seg dradd mellom jobben sin og kjæresten sin.

programme.title: The Hills: Out With The Old
programme.desc: Etter en vaklevoren sommer med kjæresten Jason, bestemmer Lauren seg for å gjøre det slutt og drar tilbake til Teen Vogue for å møte sin mindre glade sjef. Heidi får problemer med en fyr som både hun og Audrina dater.

programme.title: The Hills: When You Least Expect It
programme.desc: Lauren går på sin første date siden Jason, og blir satt på prøve på jobben når hun bes om å gjøre sitt første moteshow. Heidi har en livsavgjørende hemmelighet hun må fortelle om til kjæresten sin.

programme.title: The Hills: The Best Night Ever
programme.desc: Når Audrina dukker opp i Heidis bursdag uten invitasjon, forstår hun at Heidi ikke er villig til å tilgi og glemme. Lauren, som har bestemt seg for å konsentrere seg om jobben, blir forført av sjarmen til Brody, den nye typen i livet hennes.

programme.title: The Hills: Who Do You Trust?
programme.desc: Audrina forteller Heidi at Spencer er en lurendreier, men Heidi stiller seg tvilende - til hun ser det med egen øyne. Lauren fortsetter å lure på om hun er klar for et forhold.

programme.title: The Hills: One Big Interruption
programme.desc: Heidi tar en pause fra Spencer, men savner ham mer en hun trodde hun ville. Lauren må planlegge en Teen Vogue-middag, men distraheres når hun må hjelpe praktikanten Emily fra New York.

programme.title: The Hills: You Have Chosen
programme.desc: Når Lauren forteller Heidi hva hun egentlig syns om Spencer, må Heidi velge mellom bestevennen sin og kjæresten.

programme.title: The Hills: With Friends Like These...
programme.desc: Lauren forstår at hun ikke kan stole på bestevennene sine etter at Heidi spleiser Jen med Brody.

programme.title: The Hills: Enough Is Enough
programme.desc: Spencer ber Heidi om å flytte inn hos ham, men Heidi vet ikke hva hun skal gjøre, eller hvordan hun skal fortelle det til samboeren Lauren.

programme.title: The Hills: New Year, New Friends
programme.desc: Laurens 21-årsdag er full av overraskelser - Heidi og Audrina holder selskap for henne. Jen gjør et forsøk på å slutte fred med Lauren.

programme.title: The Hills: Apology Not Accepted
programme.desc: Lauren fyller 21 år og Heidi har store planer for bursdagsfeiringen. Men, rett før festen bestemmer Heidi seg for å fortelle Lauren om Spencers ide om at de skal flytte sammen.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Wait, That's Not an Ex
programme.desc: Nye singler kommer i en sjokkerende vri, og vender villaen opp ned. Et par tar forholdet til et nytt nivå, og skaper fyrverkeri. Hemmelighullet sjokkerer Arisce med sannheten om hva Mike egentlig syns om forholdet.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: The Ex-Husband and the Best Friend
programme.desc: En eksmann skylles i land og får en veldig kald velkomst. En eksplosiv krangel ved sannhetsbrettet presser et par til en tidlig avskjed.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Seeing is Believing
programme.desc: En eks kommer og prøver å klore seg tilbake i Rickys liv, noe som gir anspenthet i villaen. Bryce gjør alt galt med Nicole. Hemmelighullet viser Dani en sannhet hun ikke kan bortse fra.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: You Can't Get Divorced Twice
programme.desc: Kyra og Davids forhold settes på prøve da eksen de fryktet dukker opp. Sannhetsbrettet gjør så alle i villaen stiller spørsmål ved sin egen virkelighet. Ranin og Elias kjemper for å finne ut hva vennskap betyr etter skilsmissen.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Ready For More Baggage?
programme.desc: En ny eks dukker opp med gaver med en overraskende vri. Bryce får hjertesorg og gråter etter sjokkerende nyheter om Nicole. Hemmelighullet tilfører mer bagasje enn huset fikser.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Exes Court is Now In Session
programme.desc: Kyra er splittet; hun må velge Emily eller David. Noe som gjør at en av dem slynges ut i sjalusi. . Mikes eksplosive oppførsel presser Arisce ennå lenger unna. Hemmeligheter avsløres når parene stilles overfor sannhetsbrettet i den endelige dommen.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1992 Honda Civic
programme.desc: I dette avsnittet pimper teamet Christines Honda Civic. Tre dager etter at avsnittet med Christine ble sendt, døde en nær slektning av magekreft.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1990 Mitsubishi Mirage
programme.desc: I dette avsnittet pimper teamet fra West Coast Customs Antwons Mitsubishi Mirage. Antwon ruller hjem på 18-tommersdekk og med et akvarium i baksetet.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1967 Ford Mustang
programme.desc: I dette avsnittet pimper West Coast Customs Marys Ford Mustang. Bilen hennes utstyres med det aller nyeste innen flatskjerm-tv.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1985 Ford Ranger
programme.desc: I dette avsnittet pimper teamet fra West Coast Customs Jareds Ford Ranger. Jared ruller i vei tre tommer lavere, nylakkert i metallic oransje.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: Pontiac Trans Am
programme.desc: I dette avsnittet pimper West Coast Customs Danelles Pontiac Trans Am. Hun triller i vei i en bil utstyrt med kaffetrakter og krystallkrone.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1974 Chevy Luv
programme.desc: I dette avsnittet pimper gjengen fra West Coast Customs Neils Chevrolet LUV Truck. Han triller av gårde i et campingtelt på hjul.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1989 Ford Mustang
programme.desc: I dette avsnittet pimper gjengen fra West Coast Customs Shondas Ford Mustang Convertible. Hun ruller i vei i et pimpet og helt trafikksikkert kjøretøy.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: Maxima Station Wagon
programme.desc: I dette avsnittet pimper teamet fra West Coast Customs Ezras Nissan Maxima Station Wagon. Han kjører av gårde i en mobil DJ-bås.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: Volkswagen Baja
programme.desc: I dette avsnittet pimper teamet fra West Coast Customs Krissys Volkswagen Baja Bug. Boblen fra 1969 ble konstruert med holdbarhet som mål. Men med sitt bøyde eksosrør og sine ødelagte dører, kan den virkelig beskrives som alt annet enn akkurat det.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1987 Honda CRX
programme.desc: I dette avsnittet pimper teamet fra West Coast Customs Brians Honda CRX. Det er den første bilen som får en splitter ny motor, ettersom den gamle dør innen Xzibit får den inn på verkstedet.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: '72 Landcruiser
programme.desc: Gaby var en nylig dumpet yogainstruktør som ikke hadde noe i verden utenom yogamatten sin og sin Land Cruiser fra 1972. Ekskjæresten solgte bilen til henne for 200 dollar. Gutta begynner å jobbe med utsiden...

programme.title: Are You The One?: There Was A Fivesome?
programme.desc: En femkant ryster husets dynamikk. Justins selvdestruktivitet truer forholdet til Max. Danny fikser en forbindelse.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Hate to Burst Your Bubble
programme.desc: Huset vil absolutt finne ut hvilke av superparene som er perfekte for hverandre. Jonathan er fast bestemt på å få en kjærlighetsboble til å sprekke. Kai sjekker opp, rett for ansiktet på Jenna.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Red Flag Alert
programme.desc: Jonathan forsøker å gjøre det godt igjen med Basit. Et av parene kommer nærmere hverandre, mens andre sliter med å legge dårlige dating-vaner bak seg.

programme.title: Are You The One?: This Sucks and Blows
programme.desc: Venner og familie gir huset en overhaling. Jenna prøver å navigere mellom strategi og hjertet. En tur på boom-boom-rommet får eksplosive konsekvenser.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Games Players Play
programme.desc: Huset overlates til å plukke opp restene etter at Kais spiller-oppførsel har etterlatt alt i ruiner. Remy prøver å lagge sin indre spiller bak seg for å vinne Paige.

programme.title: Are You The One?: On to the Next
programme.desc: Huset strever med å bestemme de endelige tre parene. Samtidig er en person sikker på hvem parteneren blir. Nylig bekreftede perfekte par blir nærmere kjent med hverandre.

programme.title: Just Tattoo of Us: Mum's The Word
programme.desc: Festløvene Calum Best og Frankie Cocozza setter bromansen på tatoveringsprøven, men hvem av dem vil bli best? Ekteparet Ryan og Natasha har noe å utsette på hverandre, men har de gått for langt?

programme.title: Just Tattoo of Us: Danny & Jody Get Inked
programme.desc: Serien avsluttes med et brak når Drag Queen Grant tar den ultimate hevnen på sin utro kjæreste Jon. Tatovørene Danny og Jodie må takle sannheten og bestevennene Chloe og Misha designer tatoveringer til hverandre.

programme.title: Just Tattoo of Us: My Mam And Dad!
programme.desc: Charlottes kjæreste Josh er vert sammen med henne og hennes mor og far setter ekteskapet på prøve. Forretningspartnerne Scott og Stefans vennskap kan gå konk og det 26 år lange vennskapet mellom Paula og Michelle må bestå sin test.

programme.title: Just Tattoo of Us: Indecent Proposal
programme.desc: Tatovøren Charl hjelper Charlotte som vert. Vennene Saffron og Sheniya gir hverandre en beskjed, mor og sønn Mary og Lewis setter familiebåndet på prøve, mens turtelduene Emily og Chris står overfor noen store avgjørelser.

programme.title: Just Tattoo of Us: Charlotte's Revenge
programme.desc: Geordie Shore-stjernen Chloe Ferry er medvert og bestevennene Josh og Barren driver småerting helt til grensen, de tidligere flammene Harriet og Jack avslører hva de føler og Charlotte Crosby får sin hevn ved å tatovere tatovøren John.

programme.title: Just Tattoo of Us: The Last Thing I Wanted
programme.desc: Kongen av Essex, Joey Essex er vert sammen med Charlotte, og turtelduene fra Geordie Shore - Chloe og Sam - blir hardt prøvet. Becky og Zoe forteller hverandre noen sannheter og Brian og Victorias forhold legges på vektskåla.

programme.title: Mutant X: Past as Prologue
programme.desc: I et desperat forsøk på å redde sitt eget liv, gjenoppliver Ashlocke en gammel egyptisk alkymist som utgjør en dødelig trussel mot Mutant X-teamet.

programme.title: Mutant X: Power Play
programme.desc: Teamet sliter med å frigjøre en militær oberst som har truet med å slippe løs et kjernefysisk holocaust.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Possessed
programme.desc: Sydney og Nigel er i Brussel, Belgia på jakt etter den hellige soluret til Zeus for å stoppe vampyrene.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Memories of Montmartre
programme.desc: Sydney og Nigel drar til Paris, Frankrike for å finne en stjålet medaljong, slik at de kan fjerne Sydneys døde bestemor for anklagene.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: The Put Back
programme.desc: Kuba, Afrika 100 e.Kr.: Tilbedere av Woote forbanner sitt idol for å beskytte det. 2000: Ross Crawford kommer til Sydney fordi han tok avguden og forbannelsen har fått fart på aldringen hans.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: The Legend of the Lost
programme.desc: Sydney og Nigel satte ut for å finne ut om legenden om den tapte sivilisasjonen i Ny Guinea er sann. Dessverre må de slå seg sammen med Derek Lloyd.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: Fiery chef Gordon Ramsay puts two teams of aspiring chefs through a series of tough challenges. The teams meet new members before heading into a team challenge in which they must prepare a tasting menu for a dog show.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: The teams roll the dice to determine the ingredients for their next team challenge, while a contestant leaves due to an injury. The cooks cater for music legends during dinner service, including Stewart Copeland and Steven Tyler.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: Following the departure of two contestants from the competition, those remaining are challenged to create Indian-inspired meals, with the winning team earning a day of pampering at a luxurious spa.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay puts aspiring chefs through tough challenges. The teams are challenged to a blind taste test. Dinner service is held in honour of a group of decorated firefighters.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: The teams are challenged to create their own amuse bouches, with the winners enjoying a helicopter ride to a luxury location and the losers preparing coconuts for dinner service.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: The teams are tasked with creating mouthwatering steak dishes in a bid to impress Gordon and the owner of a renowned steak restaurant.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Renselsesdag
programme.desc: Walker og rangerne får hjelp av Sammo Law for å stoppe høyreekstreme fra å forårsake masseødeleggelse.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Svarte drager
programme.desc: Walker og teamet må stoppe distribueringen av en stor forsendelse med dødelig heroin i Dallas.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Hatets soldater
programme.desc: Walker og teamet må kjempe mot klokken for å stoppe en gruppe høyreekstreme fra å utløse bomber på en Dallas-samling.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Generalen vender tilbake
programme.desc: Walker og teamet må stoppe en voldelig vietnamesisk gjeng som drepte en undercover politimann som etterforsket deres ulovlige aktiviteter.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Konfrontasjon på Casa Diablo, del 1
programme.desc: Det oppstår kamp mellom Walker og et par voldelige brødre som leder et narkokartell.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Diamond
programme.desc: Henrik Durvard has taken over the country of Lombuanada by a military coup, and holds the natives in terror. He has obtained a diamond from the native miners, and the IMF is assigned to take it away from him.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Legend
programme.desc: An imprisoned member of the Nazi party, Herbert Raynor, is released from prison and is being flown to Puerto Huberra in South America, along with other Nazis.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Snowball In Hell
programme.desc: A former prison guard, Sefra, has acquired a supply of cesium 138, which explodes at temperatures above 70 degrees.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Confession
programme.desc: The team must break a Communist assassin who killed a U.S. Senator.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Action!
programme.desc: Miklos Klaar, an Iron Curtain filmmaker, has film of American soldiers and plans to edit it into an atrocity movie to discredit the U.S.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 504
programme.desc: Laura og Jesper og Jespers to barn leier i Humlebæk, og de er mildt sagt lei av det. De mangler plass, hage - og de vil også ha barn sammen snart. Men to års husjakt har ikke gitt resultat.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 505
programme.desc: Ulla og Kristian bor i en vakker herskapsleilighet på Frederiksberg med sine to barn. Men de vil ha mer plass i et barnevennlig nabolag, innom sykkelavstand fra sentrum. Kan Tobias Edlev-Nielsen finne et hus til dem?

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 506
programme.desc: En liten leiebolig i Vanløse og to små barn - ikke den beste kombinasjonen. Lisa og Erling drømmer om et stort hus med en stor hage. Tobias må jobbe hardt, da drømmene er mye større enn budsjettet.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark
programme.desc: Kristian drømmer om en diger garasje, og Nathja vil heller bli i Køge – kan Tobias oppfylle drømmene sine?

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Malmö
programme.desc: Tareq is in his hometown of Malmö – Sweden’s third largest city. The food scene here is inspired by the traditional seafood dishes and the large immigrant population whose recipes have given Malmö a new energy.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Finland's South Coast
programme.desc: Tareq takes a late autumn trip along Finland’s southern coast. He stops in the capital Helsinki to see how the city's food culture is about to be discovered by the rest of the world, and dives into the freezing waters around Ekenäs.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Kiruna
programme.desc: Tareq arrives in Kiruna, over 200km north of the Arctic Circle. With the weather getting down to -30C, Tareq takes part in snow picnics, firing up the smoker, and using snow and ice as part of the recipes he prepares.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Bergen
programme.desc: Surrounded by some of the most beautiful landscapes in northern Europe, Bergen has become a centre for the finest seafood in northern Europe. Tareq heads into this winter wonderland to see the curious cuisine that has developed in western Norway.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: The Faroe Islands
programme.desc: Tareq comes to understand what is in the soul of the Faroese, and why their cuisine has developed the way it has. We explore the beautiful capital Torshavn and surrounding villages, and sail into a cave for a recipe prepared on a rowboat.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Central Jutland
programme.desc: Volcanoes and glaciers shaped this part of the country, leaving a giant fjord and pre-historic fossils in their wake. Farmers and food innovators work closely with nature to prepare food with the area’s plentiful herbs and award-winning seafood.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Åland (Part 2)
programme.desc: Tareq goes back to Åland to explore more of this island territory. Tareq finds a chef setting up a huge food village, sees forts left over from various invaders over the centuries, and learns about beer being recreated from 200 year old DNA.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Tornedalen
programme.desc: There are not many places like Tornedalen. A rushing river has provided for locals for centuries, and the very fertile land has yielded amazing crops for centuries.Tareq explores the traditions and the food that are part of the short summer season.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's: A Duel with Interest
programme.desc: When a loan shark starts sinking his teeth into New Domino City, Jack decides to reel in this money-grubbing menace for good by putting his most prized possessions on the line in a duel.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's: The Wicked Spirits
programme.desc: When Leo and Luna decide to go exploring a nearby forest rumored to be haunted by wicked spirits, they soon discover that the rumors are all too real when a mysterious boy traps Luna in his house and challenges Leo to a duel.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's: French Twist: Part I
programme.desc: Yusei wakes up to find himself trapped in the back of a big rig with a bump on his head and no way out. After a mysterious tip leads Akiza to Yusei's location, the two friends soon find themselves Turbo Dueling an unfamiliar foe.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's: French Twist: Part II
programme.desc: As the battle between Yusei and Sherry races on, Sherry reveals some shocking secrets about the upcoming World Racing Grand Prix. Meanwhile, Akiza begins to gain a new understanding and appreciation for Turbo Dueling while riding shotgun to Yusei.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's: Synchro Straits
programme.desc: Before heading out to the event of the year - The World Racing Grand Prix Gala - Yusei challenges Jack to a Turbo Duel in the hopes of finding a new dueling strategy that doesn't involve the use of Synchro Monsters.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's: The Synchro Solution
programme.desc: A mysterious duelist named Vizor offers to show Yusei a new dueling strategy known as The Synchro Solution.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's: Acceleration
programme.desc: Akiza goes to get her Turbo Dueling license, but before she can drive off into the sunset, she first has to out-duel, out-maneuver and out-smart one of Sector Security's finest for her final exam.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's: Syd is Vicious
programme.desc: After a string of Duel Runner thefts has New Domino City on high alert, Jack Atlas decides to take justice into his own hands and ventures out in search of those responsible.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's: Dawn of the Duel Board: Part I
programme.desc: When a mysterious new student gives Luna a-one-of-a-kind Duel Board, Leo, trusting his instincts, steps up and tries to pull a 180 on their friendship.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's: Dawn of the Duel Board: Part II
programme.desc: As the Duel Board battle between Leo, Luna and the mystery duelist continues, Leo soon realizes that their mysterious opponent is actually an all-too-familiar friend.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Fight Night!

programme.title: Forensic Files: The List Murders
programme.desc: In 1971, John List left a note with the bodies of his mother, wife and three children in his mansion ballroom before disappearing completely. Detectives must solve the case, despite having only an outdated photograph of List.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Dirty Deed
programme.desc: In this classic episode of Forensic Files, the longest-running true crime series in television history, Eileen and Derrick Severs disappear from their home in a small village in Great Britain and police find evidence of foul play.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Killer Fog
programme.desc: It was the single most deadly automobile accident in American history. Almost a hundred vehicles were involved, twelve people died and more than fifty people were injured. And it happened along a stretch of highway long known for dense, thick fog.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sex, Lies and DNA
programme.desc: While vacationing in California, Earl Morris learns that his wife has gone missing from their Arizona home. The search for Ruby Morris involves dozens of investigators and scientists — and even the Coast Guard.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Charred Remains
programme.desc: Shortly after daybreak, a fire is started in a dumpster in Vancouver. No one sees the arsonist or the fire, which burns for hours in the deserted parking lot. But there's more than garbage in this flaming container.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Postal Mortem
programme.desc: On October 15, 1985, two bomb explosions rocked Salt Lake City and resulted in two deaths. A third explosion occurred the next day; this time, the victim survived.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Micro-Clues
programme.desc: After a day of fishing in a quiet village in Switzerland, a teenage boy doesn't return home as planned. The investigation reveals some important microscopic evidence in the water near where he was last seen.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Common Thread
programme.desc: After 10 bodies turn up in Florida, one victim — 17-year-old Lisa McVey — is abducted but released. She leads police to the perpertrator, Bobbie Joe Long.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bitter Potion
programme.desc: Flu-like symptoms of a mother and her children prove to be something more serious: thallium poisoning. After the mother's death, investigators turn their attention to finding the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fatal Fungus
programme.desc: An infant is rushed to the emergency room with serious breathing problems. Within months, there are more than 30 similar cases. Can doctors find the cause and a cure?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Delivery
programme.desc: In this classic episode of Forensic Files, the longest-running true crime series in television history, a serial bomber targets a judge, two attorneys and even a courthouse.

programme.title: The FBI Files: First and Kennedy Street Crew
programme.desc: In the early 1990's, Washington, D.C., became the murder capital of the nation. Few were left untouched by gang violence, which was ignited by the drug trade. By 1994, that violence would strike at the very heart of law enforcement.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Coffee Shop Murders
programme.desc: At a coffee shop in Washington, DC, three employees were shot to death. Evidence at the crime scene pointed in many different directions. Was this a hate crime, a robbery gone wrong or an act of cold-blooded vengeance?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dishonored
programme.desc: Shirley Russell was determined enough to reach the rank of Captain in the United States Marine Corps. When this officer turned up missing, her colleagues refused to believe she had gone AWOL. It was unclear whether Captain Shirley Russell was alive.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Evil Intent
programme.desc: Drops of blood and a torn screen were all that's left to tell authorities what happened to a woman in Indiana. The 21 yr. old victim was taken from her home on a spring morning. She appeared to have no real enemies, there was no clear motive.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Stranger in Town
programme.desc: She appeared on the highway in the spring, a young woman, her life cut short, her past and her identity a mystery. Only by finding out who she was could we ever hope to find her killer.

programme.title: The New Detectives: From The Ashes
programme.desc: Arson Investigation: Insurance torchings, mob burnouts and arson murders: these crimes are designed to take all clues with them. But a solid case can be built from a heap of ashes.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Murder By Numbers
programme.desc: For serial killers, once is never enough. For investigators, the challenge is steep when the killers murder by numbers.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Missing
programme.desc: Approximately 1.8 million Americans are reported missing each year. Some are runaways who find their way home, but others simply disappear. When foul play is suspected, investigators turn to forensics to find the missing.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Undaunted
programme.desc: Solving crimes may begin with gut intuition, but advanced science provides investigators with irrefutable proof. When criminals go to great lengths to mask their crimes, investigators must step up the challenge and remain forever undaunted.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Lethal Dosage
programme.desc: Toxicology: While drugs can cure disease and ease pain, they can also be agents of murder. Toxicologists can examine blood and tissue to uncover cases where death is not as natural as it may seemfrom slow arsenic poisoning to quick cocaine overdoses.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Steve Gets The Real Update
programme.desc: Megan wanted to find out if her boyfriend Devin was cheating. But even darker relationship secrets surface! Plus, you'll be shocked to find out why Laura and Steven need Steve's help again!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Falsely Accused of Molestation?
programme.desc: Desmond believes that his ex Cassandra is making up a story about him touching their child because she's jealous of his new fiancée. And later, Tammy has been investigated for child abuse and even accused of locking her kids in a closet.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Did You Leave My Kids to Die?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: If I Don't Hit Her, She Doesn't Listen

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: You Violated Me!

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Primal Instinct

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Animal Nature

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Dark Side

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gravity

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Beyond Earth Orbit, IXV Vehicles & Galileo Satellites Lost and Found

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: To The Moon, SpaceX's Dragon and Falcon & GAIA

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Seasons of Saturn

programme.title: Broad City: Coat Check

programme.title: Broad City: St. Mark's

programme.title: Broad City: 2016

programme.title: Broad City: Philadelphia

programme.title: Broad City: B&B-NYC

programme.desc: Daniel leker i trafikken med en amatør-stuntmann, finner ut om han fortsatt er den mest talenfulle i sin familie og deler noen fotballveddings-råd.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Annie Don't Fall
programme.desc: Daniel cruiser, deler rampelyset med publikum og lærer hvordan man beviser at man er klar for NFL.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Vegan Guy
programme.desc: Daniel får besøk av en vulgær vegansk sanger, snakker med en fyr som har for mye tid (å miste) og promoterer gode ereksjoner for alle.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Rifle Kid
programme.desc: Daniel tar en titt på våpenvolden, sørger for at det fins plasser å ansette sexy rekrutter til kontoret og viser hvorfor det alltid er bedre å spytte enn å svelge.

programme.title: Tosh.0: 'Ladies' Night: A Female Empowerment Episode'
programme.desc: Det er damenes aften og Daniel lovpriser alt kvinner elsker, inkludert sexy menn som kan danse, å vise følelser og i tillegg, kjendissladder.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Kitten Play
programme.desc: Daniel hilser på en spesiell pus, demonstrerer de mest skremmende måtene man kan holde en iPhone, og det er debut på Amerikas kåteste nye lek.

programme.title: Tosh.0: 'Sword Nose'
programme.desc: Daniel krysser sverd med to av Mississippis fineste, beviser at en Internett-gærning i nød er en venn tross alt, og bruker saks for å få staben til å se noenlunde moteriktig ut.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Tosh.0 Memorabilia Auction #2
programme.desc: Det er Halloween, så i denne episoden av "Tosh.0" ser vi enda eklere videoer. Dessuten avslører Daniel resultatet fra sin auksjon og viser fram en kolleksjon knapt lovlige Halloween-drakter.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Elephant Lady
programme.desc: Daniel blir kunstnerisk med en særing, beviser at en 40 år gammel komiker kan være like sexy som en ung popstjerne, og snakker med de tristeste menneskene i verden: Detroit Lions-fans.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Catfish Cooley
programme.desc: Daniel lærer mer om Catfish Cooley, og avslører den beste måten å sluke en Georgia-fersken på.
